Hello Luca,

This is written notice that we need to carry out your annual gas safety check at 19 Victoria Park Road. The current certificate runs out on 16 October 2026, and the law requires this check to be done and a copy given to you.

We have booked HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) to visit on Monday 12 October 2026, between 08:00 and 12:00. The check usually takes around an hour. If that time doesn't work, please reply with a time that suits you before 16 October and we will arrange it.

If you cannot give access, please reply to tell us when you are available. We will need access before the certificate expires.

If you have any questions, call us or reply to this email.

Kind regards,
Property Management Team

Hi Luca, your gas safety check at 19 Victoria Park Rd is booked for Mon 12 Oct, 8am-12pm (HeatRight Ltd). Certificate expires 16 Oct. Reply to confirm or suggest another time before 16 Oct. Email sent with details.

Hi Ben,

The gas safety certificate (CP12) for 19 Victoria Park Road expires on 16 October 2026. The current one was issued on 17 October 2025 and is valid until then, so the property is compliant today.

Luca Bianchi has not replied to our emails or text about the check. We have sent him written notice and booked HeatRight Ltd, a Gas Safe registered engineer and your preferred boiler contractor, for Monday 12 October, 08:00-12:00. The cost is expected to be within your £300 approval limit. We will confirm once Luca responds or the visit is done.

If the check cannot be completed before 16 October, we will come back to you for a decision.

Kind regards,
Property Management Team

Hello Luca,

This is written notice that we need to carry out your annual gas safety check at 19 Victoria Park Road. The current certificate runs out on 16 October 2026, and the law requires this check to be done and a copy given to you.

We have booked HeatRight Ltd (Gas Safe registered) to visit on Monday 12 October 2026, between 08:00 and 12:00. The check usually takes around an hour. If that time doesn't work, please reply with a time that suits you before 16 October and we will arrange it.

If you cannot give access, please reply to tell us when you are available. We will need access before the certificate expires.

If you have any questions, call us or reply to this email.

Kind regards,
Property Management Team

Hi Luca, your gas safety check at 19 Victoria Park Rd is booked for Mon 12 Oct, 8am-12pm (HeatRight Ltd). Certificate expires 16 Oct. Reply to confirm or suggest another time before 16 Oct. Email sent with details.

The gas safety certificate (CP12) for 19 Victoria Park Road expires on 16 October 2026. The current one was issued on 17 October 2025 and is valid until then, so the property is compliant today.

Luca Bianchi has not replied to our emails or text about the check. We have sent him written notice and booked HeatRight Ltd, a Gas Safe registered engineer and your preferred boiler contractor, for Monday 12 October, 08:00-12:00. The cost is expected to be within your £300 approval limit. We will confirm once Luca responds or the visit is done.

If the check cannot be completed before 16 October, we will come back to you for a decision.

Kind regards,
Property Management Team
